name: How much does it cost to replace a sliding door lock in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to replace a sliding door lock in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to replace a sliding door lock in the Bay Area varies depending on the type of lock, the complexity of the installation, and labor rates. Basic replacements might range from $150 to $350, while high-security or smart locks can cost more. This estimate typically includes the new lock hardware and professional installation. For an accurate quote tailored to your specific needs and location, it's best to contact City Dweller, LLC directly.
